description_for_human: Collections tools over Business Central data (via Dataverse virtual tables), with interactive widgets that also drive the Collections Workspace app.
description_for_model: The only source of collections data for this agent: Business Central customers, invoices, payment history, aging and risk, computed live. Use these functions for every question about a customer, an invoice, payment behavior, what to chase, aging or dashboards, including when Work IQ or Dataverse search returns records: those results lack payment history and can belong to other customers. A customer number such as DEMO-C-1001, often in parentheses after the name, is the customerNo argument.

functions.name: get_customer_context
functions.description: Customer header, aging summary, risk snapshot and top overdue invoices for one customer.

functions.name: analyze_payment_behavior
functions.description: Average days late, trend, risk score and signals for one customer.

functions.name: prioritize_collections
functions.description: Ranked chase-today worklist; renders the priority-list widget that opens invoices and the worklist in the app.

functions.name: propose_new_customer
functions.description: Proposes a new Business Central customer from an email, pasted text or document (only values found there); renders a card that opens a pre-filled new customer form, which the user reviews and saves (saving creates it in Business Central).

functions.name: propose_customer_update
functions.description: Proposes a new credit limit and/or Blocked status (Ship, Invoice, All, or unblock) for the customer the user has open; renders a card that fills the open form, which the user reviews and saves (saving writes to Business Central).

functions.name: propose_follow_up
functions.description: Proposes a follow-up (note, promise-to-pay date); renders a card the user sends to the app, which confirms before storing it.

functions.name: propose_research_note
functions.description: After web research on a customer's context (country, sector, late-payment trends, regulation), proposes a summary with sources; renders a card the user sends to the app, which confirms before storing it in the record.

functions.name: build_aging_dashboard
functions.description: Creates or revises an aging dashboard spec and renders it here and in the app.

functions.name: get_dashboard
functions.description: Current spec and data of a stored dashboard (the user may have changed it in the app).

functions.name: update_dashboard
functions.description: Patches a stored dashboard; last write wins.
